title: LAX vs. Styles & Daniels
summary: Konnan’s LAX challenges AJ Styles and Christopher Daniels for tag-team control. Their escalating feud moves through Ultimate X and Six Sides of Steel.

chapters.title: The champions withstand LAX
chapters.result: Styles and Daniels retain the NWA tag titles against Homicide and Hernandez.
chapters.context: LAX’s confrontation with the company’s celebrated homegrown stars becomes a sustained struggle for the championship.

chapters.title: Styles and Daniels reclaim the belts
chapters.result: Styles and Daniels defeat LAX in Ultimate X to win the NWA tag titles.
chapters.context: The challengers take the battle above the ring and regain the championships in TNA’s signature high-wire match.

chapters.title: LAX wins the cage showdown
chapters.result: LAX defeat Styles and Daniels inside Six Sides of Steel to regain the titles.
chapters.context: The cage match gives LAX the decisive championship win in this chapter of the rivalry.
